hooks.text: 用专属分享码把自己收集的神器直接分享给朋友
hooks.excerpt: The unique “Artifacts sharing code function” allows you to share the Artifacts you collect with your friends! !
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 让数百件神器匹配技能形成羁绊协同，用连锁力量挑战更高阶敌人
hooks.excerpt: Hundreds of different artifacts with matching skills to create a wide variety of bond Synergy, and utilize the power of the synergy to challenge higher level enemies!
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 在RPG事件和地牢选择中结识英雄、解锁角色，每轮继续出现新内容
hooks.excerpt: RPG like Events, diverse choices, adventuring dungeons, exploring magical worlds, befriend different heroes and unlock new characters! Hundreds of affixes and attributes, dozens of different meta-progressions, weapon unlocking and strengthening, and sharing your own unique artifacts with your pals! There's new contents to experience after every run!
